commands.command:
base=/srv/legacy2/filename-encoding-migration
BASE="$base" /bin/bash <<'BASH'
set -euo pipefail
src=$BASE/imported
dst=$BASE/converted
convert_rel() {
  local rel=$1 out= part rest
  while :; do
    if [[ $rel == */* ]]; then part=${rel%%/*}; rel=${rel#*/}; else part=$rel; rel=; fi
    part=$(printf '%s' "$part" | iconv -f ISO-8859-1 -t UTF-8)
    if [[ -n $out ]]; then out+="/$part"; else out=$part; fi
    [[ -n $rel ]] || break
  done
  printf '%s' "$out"
}
printf '%s\n' 'DRY-RUN source => UTF-8 destination : status'
while IFS= read -r -d '' path; do
  rel=${path#"$src"/}
  target=$dst/$(convert_rel "$rel")
  if [[ -e $target || -L $target ]]; then status=COLLISION; else status=CREATE; fi
  printf '%q => %q : %s\n' "$path" "$target" "$status"
done < <(find "$src" -mindepth 1 -print0)

commands.command:
base=/srv/legacy2/filename-encoding-migration
BASE="$base" /bin/bash <<'BASH'
set -euo pipefail
src=$BASE/imported
dst=$BASE/converted
report=$BASE/conversion-report.txt
[[ ! -e $report && ! -L $report ]] || { printf 'Refusing to overwrite existing report: %s\n' "$report" >&2; exit 1; }
convert_rel() {
  local rel=$1 out= part
  while :; do
    if [[ $rel == */* ]]; then part=${rel%%/*}; rel=${rel#*/}; else part=$rel; rel=; fi
    part=$(printf '%s' "$part" | iconv -f ISO-8859-1 -t UTF-8)
    if [[ -n $out ]]; then out+="/$part"; else out=$part; fi
    [[ -n $rel ]] || break
  done
  printf '%s' "$out"
}
report_tmp=$(mktemp "$BASE/.conversion-report.XXXXXX")
cleanup() { rm -f -- "$report_tmp"; }
trap cleanup EXIT
{
  printf '%s\n' 'Filename conversion report'
  printf '%s\n' 'Source encoding: ISO-8859-1'
  printf '%s\n' 'Destination encoding: UTF-8'
} >"$report_tmp"
created=0
collisions=0
while IFS= read -r -d '' path; do
  rel=${path#"$src"/}
  utf8_rel=$(convert_rel "$rel")
  target=$dst/$utf8_rel
  if [[ -d $path && ! -L $path ]]; then
    if mkdir -- "$target" 2>/dev/null; then
      chown --reference="$path" -- "$target"
      chmod --reference="$path" -- "$target"
      touch --reference="$path" -- "$target"
      chcon --reference="$path" -- "$target" 2>/dev/null || true
      printf 'CREATED-DIRECTORY source=%q destination=%q\n' "$path" "$target" >>"$report_tmp"
      ((created+=1))
    elif [[ -d $target && ! -L $target ]]; then
      printf 'MERGED-DIRECTORY source=%q destination=%q\n' "$path" "$target" >>"$report_tmp"
    else
      printf 'COLLISION source=%q destination=%q action=existing-destination-preserved\n' "$path" "$target" >>"$report_tmp"
      ((collisions+=1))
    fi
  else
    parent=${target%/*}
    if [[ ! -d $parent ]]; then
      printf 'COLLISION source=%q destination=%q action=parent-not-directory-source-preserved\n' "$path" "$target" >>"$report_tmp"
      ((collisions+=1))
      continue
    fi
    if [[ -e $target || -L $target ]]; then
      printf 'COLLISION source=%q destination=%q action=existing-destination-preserved\n' "$path" "$target" >>"$report_tmp"
      ((collisions+=1))
      continue
    fi
    temp=$(mktemp "$parent/.filename-migration.XXXXXX")
    rm -f -- "$temp"
    cp -a -- "$path" "$temp"
    if ln -P -- "$temp" "$target" 2>/dev/null; then
      printf 'CREATED source=%q destination=%q\n' "$path" "$target" >>"$report_tmp"
      ((created+=1))
    else
      printf 'COLLISION source=%q destination=%q action=existing-destination-preserved\n' "$path" "$target" >>"$report_tmp"
      ((collisions+=1))
    fi
    rm -f -- "$temp"
  fi
done < <(find "$src" -mindepth 1 -print0)
printf 'SUMMARY created=%d collisions=%d\n' "$created" "$collisions" >>"$report_tmp"
chmod 0644 "$report_tmp"
chown root:root "$report_tmp"
chcon --reference="$BASE/inventory.txt" "$report_tmp" 2>/dev/null || true
if ! ln -- "$report_tmp" "$report"; then
  printf 'Could not publish report without overwrite\n' >&2
  exit 1
fi
printf 'migration complete: created=%d collisions=%d\n' "$created" "$collisions"
sed -n l "$report"
BASH
